title: Product Planning Layer (Vision / Epics / Phases)
description: Add a product planning layer on top of the existing execution layer. Introduces /plan slash command for PM-style guided product planning, Epic/Phase concepts in the backlog system, vision.md output, and a product-manager agent. Enables users to plan products from 0→1 with structured Vision → Epics → Stories → Tasks hierarchy.
acceptance_criteria: backlog.json initialized by ainit-setup.sh includes last_epic_id and epics: []

node .claude/backlog.mjs create --title 't' --desc 'd' --epic EPIC-1 --phase 1 links story to epic

design.summary: Adds a two-tier planning system: Vision → Epics (EPIC-N) on top of the existing Story → Tasks layer. /plan slash command guides user through 3 rounds of PM questions and generates vision.md + Epics + initial Stories.
decisions: Epic IDs use EPIC-N format, parallel to STORY-N
Epic detail files stored in backlog/EPIC-N.json
backlog.json gains last_epic_id and epics[] array
vision.md uses a standardized markdown template
Phase is an integer (1, 2, 3) not a string
